Use case: ui-mockup. Produce a polished high resolution approval reference board with EXACTLY TWO complete mobile app screens side by side, each portrait 852:1846 aspect, at least 2000 pixels tall if supported. Flat front-on UI, no devices, no perspective. Input image 1 is the OWNER APPROVED visual system, NOT an inspiration for redesign: faithfully preserve its dark vertical walnut boards, SAME sculpted antique gold botanical perimeter frame, SAME rectangular gold carved panel corners, emerald gemstone accents, restrained emerald active state, warm ivory Cyrillic typography, branded top cartouche with exact 'MaestroVPN'. All screens look from this exact same app. Use the reference's smaller rectangular panel frames, never fat oval bars. Match material/color/ornament precisely; keep ornamental pixels OUTSIDE content areas. Clean edges, crisp lettering, generous readable content padding, absolutely no clipped letters, black/green rectangular artifact backplates, warped borders, duplicated icons or gibberish. Preserve gold/wood aesthetics, do NOT substitute flat modern cards or gradients. Both screens same scale, width, header height, footer position. Use a small dark neutral gutter between screens, no large external headings. Bottom navigation on both: 'Главная', 'Серверы', 'Подписка', 'Настройки', four gold icons and emerald active state. Clearly readable Russian text as specified. Any sample 29 days/9.8GB are mock data. No made-up operational proof or ping numbers.
LEFT: HOME, keep composition and proportions almost identical to input1; eye now OPEN with natural iris from input2, retained inside input1's original carved medallion. Wide top button 'Ввести логин' with person icon; immediately to its right a small separate framed paper-plane button labelled 'Бот' (both must fit). Two balance panels 'VPN: 29 дней' and 'CDN: 9,8 ГБ'. Large beautiful realistic green eye central, status green 'Подключено', below 'Нажмите на глаз, чтобы отключить'. Two-part mode switch 'Обычный VPN' and 'CDN', CDN selected emerald. Server row small Netherlands flag, 'Нидерланды', subtitle 'CDN · выбранный сервер', chevron. Two bottom action buttons 'Продлить VPN' and 'Купить ГБ'. Main nav active 'Главная'. No oversize spaced typography.
RIGHT: SERVER SELECTION, branded header then back arrow and 'Серверы'. Same wood, gold frame. Top mode switch 'Обычный VPN' / 'CDN' with CDN active. Smaller text 'CDN: 9,8 ГБ' then 'Выберите сервер'. Four beautiful spaced carved rectangular selectable rows with correctly drawn country flags and names: 'Испания', 'Чехия', 'Нидерланды', 'Германия'. Each subtitle 'CDN · XHTTP', no fake pings. Netherlands row has emerald selected radio/check. Separate subdued panel text 'CDN работает в мобильной сети' and 'При Wi-Fi используется обычный VPN'. Button 'Обновить список'. Nav active 'Серверы'. Retain breathing room; no eye on this secondary screen.
